3pub(super) fn move_trigger_card_to_hand(env: &mut GameEnv, controller: u8, source_id: CardId) {
4    let _ = env.move_trigger_card_from_stock_to_hand(controller, source_id);
5}
6
7pub(super) fn move_trigger_card_to_stock(env: &mut GameEnv, controller: u8) {
8    let p = controller as usize;
9    let Some(instance_id) = env
10        .state
11        .turn
12        .attack
13        .as_ref()
14        .and_then(|ctx| ctx.trigger_instance_id)
15    else {
16        return;
17    };
18    if let Some(pos) = env.state.players[p]
19        .resolution
20        .iter()
21        .position(|card| card.instance_id == instance_id)
22    {
23        let card = env.state.players[p].resolution.remove(pos);
24        env.move_card_between_zones(controller, card, Zone::Resolution, Zone::Stock, None, None);
25    }
26}
27
28pub(super) fn standby(env: &mut GameEnv, controller: u8, payload: &EffectPayload, target_slot: u8) {
29    let Some(target) = payload.targets.first() else {
30        return;
31    };
32    if target.zone != TargetZone::WaitingRoom {
33        return;
34    }
35    let option = ChoiceOptionRef {
36        card_id: target.card_id,
37        instance_id: target.instance_id,
38        zone: ChoiceZone::WaitingRoom,
39        index: Some(target.index as u16),
40        target_slot: Some(target_slot),
41    };
42    env.move_waiting_room_to_stage_standby(controller, option);
43}

45pub(super) fn treasure_stock(env: &mut GameEnv, controller: u8, take_stock: bool) {
46    if take_stock {
47        if let Some(card) = env.draw_from_deck(controller) {
48            env.move_card_between_zones(controller, card, Zone::Deck, Zone::Stock, None, None);
49        }
50    }
51}

53pub(super) fn set_trigger_check_count(env: &mut GameEnv, count: u8) {
54    if let Some(ctx) = &mut env.state.turn.attack {
55        let desired = count.max(1);
56        let floor = ctx.trigger_checks_resolved.max(1);
57        ctx.trigger_checks_total = ctx.trigger_checks_total.max(desired).max(floor);
58    }
59}

61pub(super) fn trigger_icon(
62    env: &mut GameEnv,
63    controller: u8,
64    source_id: CardId,
65    payload: &EffectPayload,
66    icon: TriggerIcon,
67) {
68    let trigger_id = env.state.turn.next_trigger_id;
69    env.state.turn.next_trigger_id = env.state.turn.next_trigger_id.wrapping_add(1);
70    let trigger = PendingTrigger {
71        id: trigger_id,
72        group_id: 0,
73        player: controller,
74        source_card: source_id,
75        effect: match icon {
76            TriggerIcon::Soul => TriggerEffect::Soul,
77            TriggerIcon::Draw => TriggerEffect::Draw,
78            TriggerIcon::Shot => TriggerEffect::Shot,
79            TriggerIcon::Bounce => TriggerEffect::Bounce,
80            TriggerIcon::Choice => TriggerEffect::Choice,
81            TriggerIcon::Pool => TriggerEffect::Pool,
82            TriggerIcon::Treasure => TriggerEffect::Treasure,
83            TriggerIcon::Gate => TriggerEffect::Gate,
84            TriggerIcon::Standby => TriggerEffect::Standby,
85        },
86        effect_id: Some(payload.spec.id),
87    };
88    let trigger_effect = trigger.effect;
89    let resolved = match icon {
90        TriggerIcon::Draw => env.resolve_trigger_draw(trigger),
91        TriggerIcon::Choice => env.resolve_trigger_choice(trigger),
92        TriggerIcon::Pool
93        | TriggerIcon::Soul
94        | TriggerIcon::Shot
95        | TriggerIcon::Gate
96        | TriggerIcon::Bounce => {
97            let _ = env.resolve_trigger(trigger);
98            false
99        }
100        TriggerIcon::Treasure => env.resolve_trigger_treasure(trigger),
101        TriggerIcon::Standby => env.resolve_trigger_standby(trigger),
102    };
103    if !resolved && env.state.turn.choice.is_none() {
104        env.log_event(Event::TriggerResolved {
105            trigger_id,
106            player: controller,
107            effect: trigger_effect,
108        });
109    }
110}
